faq.q: Will an AI chatbot make things up?
faq.a: It can, which is why we build it to answer from your own content, to say when it doesn't know, and to hand over to a person. That reduces wrong answers a lot, but no AI is perfect, so we keep a person in the loop for anything important.

faq.q: Can it reply in Urdu and Roman Urdu?
faq.a: Current AI models handle English, Urdu and Roman Urdu. We test the assistant with real messages from your customers before it goes live.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: There is the build, and then a running cost for the AI service that grows with the number of conversations. We estimate both in the proposal so there are no surprises.

faq.q: What is the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent?
faq.a: A chatbot answers questions. An agent can also take actions with your tools, such as updating a booking or drafting a follow-up email. We give agents limited permissions and ask for approval before anything that spends money or contacts a customer.
